A single ultra-detailed cyberpunk pop-art poster fills the frame with a metallic, futuristic female protagonist in a dense neon city setting. The style is highly artistic, graphic, and poster-like, combining comic-book linework, pop-art color blocking, chrome reflections, and cyberpunk lighting. The palette is dominated by saturated magenta, hot pink, cyan, electric blue, black, silver, and warm orange accents. The composition is vertical and tightly packed, with the woman occupying the right half and oversized typography dominating the left half.

On the upper-left side, large stacked headline lettering appears in thick block forms with distressed texture, dark shadows, and metallic highlights. The top line reads "CYBERPUNK" in bright pink and silver, followed below by "FUTURE" in pale blue-gray, then "IS NOW" in white and gray, and lower down "LIVE" in bold yellow-orange letters. Beneath this headline block, smaller stacked text reads "NOT TOMORROW", set in compact uppercase type with a weathered printed texture. The typography has heavy outlines, beveled edges, worn speckling, and a three-dimensional signboard quality, making it feel like part of the neon city environment.

Across the central-left area, a large circular neon sign sits behind the woman’s head and shoulder. It glows in concentric rings of pink, red, orange, and yellow, with radial burst lines extending outward. Inside the circle, a stylized female profile illustration appears in pale cream and pink tones, framed by angular starburst shapes. Below the circle, a rectangular neon billboard contains a small portrait of an androgynous figure wearing sunglasses and a dark jacket, rendered in sharp black-and-white comic shading. Nearby, another rectangular sign shows a dark mask-like face or helmet shape against a pale background, adding to the layered advertising-board atmosphere.

The main woman is shown from the chest upward on the right side, angled slightly toward the viewer while looking off to the right with a calm, serious expression. She appears as a young adult East Asian woman with smooth light-to-medium skin, an oval face, defined cheekbones, full lips, and almond-shaped eyes. Her makeup is dramatic and polished: dark eyeliner, long lashes, warm eyeshadow, sculpted brows, subtle blush, and glossy rose-toned lipstick. Her hair is black, wet-looking, tousled, and pulled back loosely, with strands catching blue and magenta highlights. A metallic cybernetic headset wraps around her
